summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026-27 season with just one week until kick-off, having strengthened the squad with several new signings and a returning player. The Ramblers are looking to make a push for promotion and are actively seeking sponsorship opportunities to support the campaign. Following a narrow defeat to St Helens in a recent friendly, the team will be hoping to hit the ground running when the season starts.
